in_marathi.name: Aswin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ashwini Kumaras, horse-born gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aswin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, the Ashwini Kumaras are the celestial twin horse-born physicians. They are also known as the 'gods of fertility' and 'healing'. The name Aswin is derived from their names.
